targetsystem.desc: [BL2.6.0] No use of critical auth. profile SAP_NEW (ABAP)

checkitem.desc: [p1-CRITICAL] No users assigned the critical authorization profile SAP_NEW
checkitem.compliant: PROFILE = 'SAP_NEW' AND STATUS in ('NONE','NOT_EXISTING') and USERNAME != 'DDIC' and USER_TYPE like '%' and USER_GROUP like '%' and USER_LOCKED like '%' and USER_INVALID like '%'
checkitem.noncompliant: PROFILE = 'SAP_NEW' AND STATUS not in ('NONE','NOT_EXISTING') and USERNAME != 'DDIC' and USER_TYPE like '%' and USER_GROUP like '%' and USER_LOCKED like '%' and USER_INVALID like '%'

checkitem.desc: [p1-CRITICAL] No DIALOG users assigned the critical authorization profile SAP_NEW

checkitem.desc: [p1-CRITICAL] No SYSTEM users assigned the critical authorization profile SAP_NEW

checkitem.desc: [p1-CRITICAL] No COMMUNICATION users assigned the critical authorization profile SAP_NEW
checkitem.noncompliant: PROFILE = 'SAP_NEW' AND STATUS like '%' and USERNAME != 'DDIC' and USER_TYPE = 'COMMUNICATION' and USER_GROUP like '%' and USER_LOCKED like '%' and USER_INVALID like '%'

checkitem.desc: [p1-CRITICAL] Critical profile SAP_NEW has been added to user in last 30 days - Review if needed
checkitem.compliant: USER like '%' and ACTION = 'ADDED' and PROFILE = 'SAP_NEW' and USER_TYPE like '%' and USER_GROUP like '%' and USER_LOCKED like '%' and USER_INVALID like '%' and CD_HIST_DATE > to_decimal(to_varchar(add_seconds(CURRENT_UTCTIMESTAMP,-86400*30), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')) and MODIFIED_BY like_regexpr '^\s*$'
checkitem.noncompliant: USER like '%' and ACTION = 'ADDED' and PROFILE = 'SAP_NEW' and USER_TYPE like '%' and USER_GROUP like '%' and USER_LOCKED like '%' and USER_INVALID like '%' and CD_HIST_DATE > to_decimal(to_varchar(add_seconds(CURRENT_UTCTIMESTAMP,-86400*30), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')) and MODIFIED_BY not like_regexpr '^\s*$'

checkitem.desc: [p1-CRITICAL] No users assigned the critical authorization role SAP_NEW
checkitem.compliant: CHECK_ID = 'SAP_NEW' and ROLE like '%' and USER like '%' and USER_TYPE like '%' and USER_GROUP like '%' and USER_LOCKED like '%' and USER_INVALID like '%' and length(USER_COUNT) = 0
checkitem.noncompliant: CHECK_ID = 'SAP_NEW' and ROLE like '%' and USER like '%' and USER_TYPE like '%' and USER_GROUP like '%' and USER_LOCKED like '%' and USER_INVALID like '%' and length(USER_COUNT) != 0
